title: 港股低开确认油债压力，恒科权重普跌；比亚迪、兖煤与VALA催化待价格验证
summary: A股国庆休市、港股10月2日复市且南向资金缺席。09:20 CST开市反馈显示恒指跌2.09%、恒科跌1.81%，阿里、腾讯、小米等科技权重约跌2.1%至2.5%，实际弱开已取代盘前温和期指基线。纳指100期货约涨0.26%、WTI期货约涨0.06%，未能抵消高油价与高利率压力。比亚迪、兖煤澳大利亚、VALA继续仅列条件关注，觅瑞列回避；美股排行快照仍未覆盖10月1日交易时段，两组维持0行降级。

关键词云图

港股低开油价上行美债高位比亚迪出口炼焦煤并购存储景气科技融合数字经济互联互通休市新能源车内卷结果延迟期指微升
利好利空中性
重大新闻汇总
国际
中东紧张推高油价，能源安全重新主导风险溢价
隔夜布伦特收于102.31美元、WTI收于92.87美元；美国增派航母的报道令供应风险升温。港股油气上游获得价格支撑，航空、物流与高耗能下游成本压力上升。
宏观
美债剧烈反转后仍居高位，港股成长估值承压
美国10年期收益率盘中触及5.34%的2002年以来高位，后随美联储官员偏耐心表态回落；标普500最终涨0.19%，道指和纳指各约涨0.04%。
政策
上海青浦数字经济与数智化措施进入兑现窗口
上海市政府政策页面显示相关措施申报/兑付期为10月1日至23日，直接线索集中在数字化项目、平台与服务交付；应以真实订单和回款确认受益。
政策
福建发布科技创新与产业创新深度融合决定
福建省政府10月1日发布省人大常委会决定，强调创新驱动、新质生产力与产业融合；区域科创平台、先进制造和成果转化形成中期政策线索。
产业
华为与赛力斯升级问界五年合作
问界披露双方签署新的五年战略合作，强化智能汽车平台与产品协同；内地休市使A股暂无法价格确认，港股汽车链关注竞品与供应链映射。
市场
港股低开，恒指跌2.09%、恒科跌1.81%
09:20 CST开市反馈显示恒指与恒科同步走弱，阿里约跌2.4%、腾讯跌2.09%、小米跌2.46%。南向资金缺席叠加高油价与高利率，实际价格已否定盘前“分化开盘、期指托底”的基准判断。
公司
比亚迪9月销量增长，出口成为主要增量
公司公告及Reuters核验显示9月全球销量463,561辆，同比增17%；海外乘用车与皮卡179,877辆，同比增153.9%。国内需求偏弱与价格竞争是主要反证。
公司
兖煤澳大利亚完成红隼煤矿80%权益收购
港交所公告显示交易10月1日完成，公司自当日起确认应占产量、收入与利润；前期披露的18.5亿美元首付款、12亿美元贷款及最高5.5亿美元或有款构成杠杆与煤价风险。
公司
觅瑞复牌进度未解，继续停牌
公司10月1日公告继续停牌，仍涉及2025年年度业绩延迟、调查与复牌指引，并已延迟2026年中期业绩；该事件属于明确负面披露与流动性风险。
公司
VALA与五菱工业合作车型开始首批交付
港交所公告称9月下旬第三款vala车型kcar已向首批车主交付。事件验证产品落地，但尚无订单规模、收入贡献与公告后价格反馈，不能直接外推盈利。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
夜盘指数
09:28 CST抓取的延迟公开报价显示纳指100期货+0.26%、标普500期货+0.09%、道指期货-0.01%；来源未披露标的报价时间，WTI期货+0.06%，因此只作为方向参考。
板块对照
板块对照
当前排行快照未覆盖10月1日美股时段，行业与概念均0行，无法逐项做确认、背离或潜在反转；隔夜现金市场仅能确认能源领涨、咨询与存储事件驱动，不能替代排行。
A/H映射
A/H映射
A股休市；港股实际低开，09:20 CST恒指跌2.09%、恒科跌1.81%，科技权重普遍跌约2.1%至2.5%。温和偏强的纳指期货未能抵消本地卖压，能源与公司事件只能按相对防御或条件催化处理。

盘前结论

A股继续休市至10月7日；港股今日复市且南向资金缺席，09:20 CST恒指跌2.09%、恒科跌1.81%。9月30日AKShare仍只作上一交易时段基线；今日实际开盘已覆盖该基线，科技权重约跌2.1%至2.5%。

比亚迪出口、兖煤已完成收购及区域科技政策提供结构性催化。运行时纳指期货约涨0.26%，但布伦特站上102美元、10年期美债收益率曾触及5.34%，限制成长股估值扩张。

开盘反馈确认风险偏好走弱：恒科虽相对恒指少跌，但权重普跌，不能视为科技修复。只有关注股可靠刷新后守住前收并取得行业正超额，个股催化才获确认；否则优先防守。

重点个股关注

比亚迪股份
HK.01211 / SZ.002594
条件关注
9月全球销量同比增17%，海外乘用车与皮卡出货同比增153.9%；9月30日港股延迟报价HK$75.60，复核时未取得可靠刷新的个股成交，且大盘低开。
确认条件：可靠刷新后守住9月30日收盘并相对恒指/汽车板块取得正超额；国内销量与价格竞争不能继续恶化。
风险/失效：出口不能完全抵消国内需求、折扣与利润率压力；跌破前收且放量弱于同业则取消关注。
兖煤澳大利亚
HK.03668
条件关注
10月1日完成红隼煤矿80%权益收购；首付款18.5亿美元，收购贷款12亿美元，另有最高5.5亿美元或有款。Etnet延迟页显示9月30日收盘HK$31.92。
确认条件：取得可靠刷新后守住前收且煤炭板块同步走强，市场接受新增产量与负债的组合；复核时尚未确认。
风险/失效：高油煤价虽提供支撑，但杠杆、整合、资本开支及煤价回落均可能反噬；明显弱于煤炭同业则失效。
VALA
HK.02051
条件关注
与五菱工业共研的kcar在9月下旬启动首批交付；第三季度交付420辆、其中kcar 90辆。09:01 CST页面仍报HK$0.340且成交量为0，不构成公告后价格确认。
确认条件：公司进一步披露订单/交付规模，且复市后至少收复前收并出现可持续成交。
风险/失效：单纯首批交付不等于规模收入；若继续弱于前收或无订单数据，保留观察而不升级。
觅瑞
HK.02629
回避
10月1日公告继续停牌，2025年年度及2026年中期业绩延迟，复牌指引与调查事项未完成；无可交易报价。
解除条件：补发经审计业绩、完成调查和复牌指引并恢复有序交易。
风险/失效：信息不对称、审计与持续停牌风险明确，任何未核验复牌传闻均不构成转多依据。

板块轮动看板

油气/煤炭上游油价站上102美元与红隼煤矿交割支撑相对防御，但恒指低开说明宏观风险溢价占优，仍需本地股价确认。
新能源车出口比亚迪出口高增是直接催化，国内需求与利润率限制定价强度。
AI存储/数字经济政策线索偏正面，但恒科低开1.81%、权重普跌，价格尚未确认修复。
航空/长久期成长油价和利率双高抬升成本与折现压力，不能把期指微升当成全面反转。

逻辑链

中东供应风险推高油价至102美元上方，全球通胀敏感度维持高位。
美债高收益率限制成长股整体重估，纳指期货约涨0.26%未能阻止港股低开。
港股在南向资金缺席下低开，实际价格确认宏观压力并放大公司事件波动。
优先选择有真实催化且确认/失效条件清晰的标的，回避停牌及披露受损公司。

风险雷达

利率与油价10年期美债再上5.3%或油价继续上冲，可能加剧已在港股低开中出现的风险偏好收缩。
资金缺口互联互通休市使南向支撑缺席，港股主题股跳空与波动可能放大。
快照时效AKShare与美股排行均未覆盖今日港股或最新美股现金时段，旧数据未被当作当前行情。

数据来源与时间点

数据来源与截止：港交所公告（比亚迪、兖煤澳大利亚、觅瑞、VALA）、港交所2026年交易日历及互联互通日历、上海与福建政府政策页、Reuters、MarketWatch，以及09:20 CST新浪港股直播/延迟行情页。国内政策与交易所公告已复核08:36 CST后增量，未发现改变结论的新项；例行百度回购信息未达到实质更新门槛。AKShare底层仍为9月30日行情。运行时期指于09:28 CST从延迟公开报价抓取，标的报价时间未披露。美股排行快照仍停留于10月1日09:32 CST，因未覆盖10月1日美股时段而维持0行。生成时间：2026-10-02 09:36 CST。

Keyword Cloud

Hong Kong weak openOil surgeHigh Treasury yieldsBYD exportsCoking-coal acquisitionMemory cycleTech-industry integrationDigital economyStock Connect closedEV price competitionDelayed resultsFutures edge up
BullishBearishNeutral
Major News Roundup
Global
Middle East tension lifts oil and restores an energy-risk premium
Brent settled at $102.31 and WTI at $92.87 as reports of additional U.S. carrier deployment lifted supply-risk premiums. Hong Kong upstream energy gains support while airlines, logistics and energy-intensive downstreams face higher costs.
Macro
Treasuries reverse sharply but remain high, pressuring growth valuations
The U.S. 10-year yield touched 5.34%, the highest since 2002, then eased after patient Fed commentary. The S&P 500 closed up 0.19%, while the Dow and Nasdaq each gained about 0.04%.
Policy
Qingpu digital-economy measures enter their application window
Shanghai's government policy page shows an Oct 1–23 application/redemption window. The direct read-through is to digital projects, platforms and services, with benefits requiring verified orders and collections.
Policy
Fujian issues decision on deeper technology-industry integration
Fujian's government published a provincial legislative decision on Oct 1 emphasizing innovation, new productive forces and industrial integration, creating a medium-term signal for platforms, advanced manufacturing and commercialization.
Industry
Huawei and Seres upgrade their five-year AITO partnership
AITO disclosed a new five-year strategic agreement between Huawei and Seres, reinforcing smart-vehicle platform and product coordination. Mainland closure prevents A-share price confirmation, while Hong Kong auto names face competitive and supply-chain read-throughs.
Market
Hong Kong opens weak: HSI -2.09%, HSTECH -1.81%
At 09:20 CST, both indexes were lower, with Alibaba about -2.4%, Tencent -2.09% and Xiaomi -2.46%. Absent Southbound flows plus high oil and yields invalidate the pre-open base case of a mixed opening supported by mild futures gains.
Company
BYD September sales grow as exports become the main increment
Company disclosure and Reuters verification show 463,561 global vehicle sales in September, up 17% year on year; overseas passenger/pickup shipments reached 179,877, up 153.9%. Weak domestic demand and price competition are the key counter-evidence.
Company
Yancoal completes acquisition of 80% of Kestrel
The HKEX filing says completion occurred on Oct 1 and Yancoal begins recognizing its share of output, revenue and profit from that date. The previously disclosed $1.85 billion upfront payment, $1.2 billion loan and up to $550 million contingent payment create leverage and coal-price risks.
Company
Mirxes remains suspended with resumption work unresolved
The Oct 1 filing keeps Mirxes suspended amid delayed 2025 annual results, investigation and resumption guidance, while 2026 interim results are also delayed. This is a clear negative disclosure and liquidity event.
Company
VALA begins first deliveries of a Wuling Industrial co-developed model
An HKEX filing says first deliveries of the third Vala model, kcar, began in late September. This validates product launch but provides no order scale, revenue contribution or post-announcement price feedback, so profit impact cannot be assumed.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight indexes
Overnight indexes
Delayed public quotes fetched at 09:28 CST showed Nasdaq-100 futures +0.26%, S&P 500 futures +0.09% and Dow futures -0.01%; the source did not disclose underlying quote timestamps. WTI futures were +0.06%, so these are directional references only.
Sector comparison
Sector comparison
The current ranking snapshot does not cover the Oct 1 U.S. session, leaving both groups at zero rows; row-by-row confirmation, divergence or potential reversal is unavailable. Cash-market evidence only confirms energy leadership and event-driven consulting/memory strength and does not substitute for rankings.
A/H mapping
A/H mapping
Mainland A shares are closed; Hong Kong actually opened lower, with HSI -2.09% and HSTECH -1.81% at 09:20 CST and major tech names down about 2.1%–2.5%. Mildly positive Nasdaq futures did not offset local selling, so energy and company events remain relative-defense or conditional-catalyst ideas only.

Pre-market Conclusion

Mainland A shares remain closed through Oct 7; Hong Kong reopened without Southbound flows, with HSI -2.09% and HSTECH -1.81% at 09:20 CST. Sep 30 AKShare data remain prior-session baselines only; today’s actual open supersedes them, with tech heavyweights down about 2.1%–2.5%.

BYD exports, Yancoal's completed acquisition and regional technology policy create selective catalysts. Nasdaq-100 futures were about +0.26%, but Brent above $102 and the U.S. 10-year yield recently touching 5.34% constrain valuation expansion.

The open confirms weaker risk appetite: HSTECH fell less than HSI but broad heavyweight losses do not qualify as a tech repair. Stock catalysts are confirmed only if reliably refreshed quotes hold prior closes and outperform their industries; otherwise prioritize defense.

Key Stocks

BYD Company
HK.01211 / SZ.002594
Conditional watch
September global sales rose 17% and overseas passenger/pickup shipments 153.9%; the latest reliable delayed quote remains HK$75.60 on Sep 30, while no reliably refreshed stock trade was obtained and the market opened weak.
Confirmation: after a reliable quote refresh, hold the Sep 30 close and outperform HSI/auto peers; domestic sales and pricing pressure must not deteriorate.
Risk/invalidation: exports may not fully offset domestic demand, discounting and margin pressure; a volume-backed break below the prior close versus peers cancels the watch.
Yancoal Australia
HK.03668
Conditional watch
Completed the 80% Kestrel acquisition on Oct 1; $1.85 billion upfront, a $1.2 billion acquisition loan and up to $550 million contingent. An Etnet delayed page shows a Sep 30 close of HK$31.92.
Confirmation: after a reliable quote refresh, hold the prior close with coal peers also firm, showing the market accepts the output/debt mix; this was not yet confirmed at review time.
Risk/invalidation: high energy prices help, but leverage, integration, capex and coal-price reversal can offset benefits; clear underperformance versus coal peers invalidates.
VALA
HK.02051
Conditional watch
First deliveries of the Wuling Industrial co-developed kcar began in late September; Q3 deliveries were 420 vehicles including 90 kcar units. A 09:01 CST page still showed HK$0.340 with zero volume, which is not post-announcement price confirmation.
Confirmation: disclose order/delivery scale and reclaim at least the prior close with sustainable turnover after reopening.
Risk/invalidation: first deliveries do not equal scaled revenue; continued weakness below the prior close or no order data prevents an upgrade.
Mirxes
HK.02629
Avoid
The Oct 1 filing continues suspension; 2025 annual and 2026 interim results are delayed and resumption guidance/investigation remain incomplete. No tradable quote exists.
Removal condition: publish audited results, complete investigation/resumption guidance and restore orderly trading.
Risk/invalidation: disclosure, audit and suspension risks are explicit; unverified resumption rumors do not support a bullish shift.

Sector Rotation Board

Upstream energyOil above $102 and Kestrel completion offer relative defense, but the weak HSI open shows the macro risk premium dominates; local price confirmation remains necessary.
EV exportsBYD export acceleration is the direct catalyst; domestic demand and margins cap conviction.
AI memory / digital economyPolicy signals help, but HSTECH opened down 1.81% with broad heavyweight losses, so price action has not confirmed a repair.
Airlines / high-duration growthOil and rates raise costs and discount pressure; avoid treating mild futures gains as a full reversal.

Logic Chain

Middle East supply risk lifts oil above $102 and keeps global inflation sensitivity high.
High yields cap broad growth re-rating; Nasdaq futures near +0.26% did not prevent Hong Kong’s weak open.
Hong Kong opened weak without Southbound flows, confirming macro pressure and amplifying company-specific volatility.
Favor verified catalysts with explicit confirmation and invalidation conditions; avoid suspended or disclosure-impaired names.

Risk Radar

Rates and oilAnother move above 5.3% in the U.S. 10-year or further oil gains could deepen the risk-off move already visible in Hong Kong’s weak open.
Flow gapStock Connect closure removes Southbound support and may widen gaps in thematic Hong Kong names.
Stale snapshotsAKShare and U.S. ranking files do not cover today's Hong Kong session or the latest U.S. cash session; no stale row is treated as current.

Sources and Time

Sources and cut-off: HKEX filings (BYD, Yancoal, Mirxes, VALA), HKEX 2026 calendar and Stock Connect calendar, Shanghai and Fujian government policy pages, Reuters, MarketWatch, and the 09:20 CST Sina Hong Kong live/delayed quote pages. Post-08:36 CST domestic-policy and exchange-announcement increments were rechecked; no new item changed the judgment, and a routine Baidu buyback item did not meet the material-update threshold. AKShare underlying data remain Sep 30 only. Runtime futures were fetched at 09:28 CST from delayed public quotes with undisclosed underlying timestamps. The U.S. ranking snapshot remains at Oct 1 09:32 CST and stays at zero rows because it misses the Oct 1 U.S. session. Generated 2026-10-02 09:36 CST.
